route_decisions.decision: Reuse fixed-support raw-array statistics, profiles, and source-bound review.
route_decisions.reason: Raising max_peaks does not supply missing-column evidence. A missing site may have no bright maximum; free-center fitting could move toward a neighboring column. Existing review did not admit saved real-space statistics/profile evidence.
rejected_or_deferred: Changing the existing peak detector, cap, ranking, or adding a universal classifier
A new atom-column detector or unconstrained Gaussian fitting without applicability evidence
route_decisions.attribution_limit: A prior physical MoS2 comparison with 18 above-threshold maxima and cap16, and unchanged peak positions after cap expansion, was reported from a separate controlled experiment; the point-observation local experiment did not possess or independently reproduce that source array.

route_decisions.decision: Use an explicit physical forward model and a frozen convergence gate before formal blind qualification.
route_decisions.reason: The Gaussian intensity proxy cannot establish probe, scattering, detector, or physical vacancy validity. One bounded refinement was permitted; a failing physical gate is retained rather than selecting a grid that passes.

route_decisions.decision: Correct receipt recovery guidance and preserve the preview-admission safety gate.
route_decisions.reason: Preview acknowledgements, scientific frame versus display-view identity, and existing export parents were operational obstacles. Repairing them must not relabel failed physical evidence or claim better defect recognition.

route_decisions.decision: Stop after the pre-frozen 18 propagated positions.
route_decisions.reason: The GridScan/CustomScan comparison only probes path consistency at selected sites. It cannot replace the original 225-point metric and 10-percent gate.
route_decisions.future_only: At most24 fixed points for co-translated atom/scan grid-phase control, then only if necessary at most 12 node-preserving points. Neither was run during this note preparation.

Peak-cap residual maxima are not a count of independent reflections or phases.

model.intervention: Delete one geometrically topmost S at a selected projected S2 column; projected S2 becomes S, the other S is retained.

finite_physics_path.input: Existing native float32 saved potentials, 15 slices; no new potential construction and no full-image scan.
finite_physics_path.selection: Geometry only: center/four sampled corners of primaryROI plus first 4 distance-ordered reference centers; 2 states.
finite_physics_path.qualification: No large path discrepancy at these 9 sites; not all 225 sites, convergence proof, or explanation of the 10.034456-percent grid failure.

grid_failure_diagnosis.checked: Same states, same ROI/reference order, 225 coordinates; no transposition/group mismatch found.
grid_failure_diagnosis.observations: Same extent / 15 slices and 15096 physical frequency points in 90-200mrad ring. Near-core radial quadrature lower bound, atom/grid phase and propagation bandwidth change; target fine-grid y phase 7/9. Stored delta-potential area integral changes about 0.053 percent and ring potential Fourier power about 4.638 percent.
grid_failure_diagnosis.interpretation: Evidence of discretization variation; potential-power change is not STEM-intensity change and does not uniquely explain the full instability. No directly established abTEM defect.
grid_failure_diagnosis.next_steps: At most24 fixed co-translated atom/scan positions, and only if needed at most 12 node-preserving positions were proposed, not executed here. Original225-point metric and 10percent gate remain required.
